raw_segments.text: Something's splendid," said Ermingard, in an excited hurry.
"'This very afternoon my nicest aunt sent me a box.
It is full of good things.
I had so much pudding at dinner and I was so bothered about Papa's books.'
Her words began to tumble over each other.
"'It's got cake in it and little meat pies and jammed tarts and buns and oranges
and redcurrant wine and figs and chocolate.
I'll creep back to my room and get it this minute and we'll eat it now.'"
